pairs.subject: plan-entitlements
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/book/rules.ts:17 The Book is a merchant's read-only ledger and query mirror. Its only 'subscription' vocabulary is a ledger view over the merchant's own PayPal billing records (paypal.subscription on a deal), not a plan the product sells to its tenant. Searching the context's directories (modules/book, console/areas, lib/words) found no entitlement, paywall, premium, pricing or plan_id, and no tier model, capability gate or upgrade prompt, so the precondition of the subject (a product with paid tiers that gate features) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/modules/book/rules.ts:33 This is the only gate-like predicate in the module. It rejects a query by its shape (views, metrics, filters) and never asks about a plan, so no plan capability is being gated.
